\cpara{The narrator's diagnosis: she was blocked because she was ``trying to repeat, in her writing, things she had already heard.'' This is close to the idea of ``Cached Thoughts,'' posted three days before. The post leaves the connection to the reader.}

\cfact{The book goes on where the post stops. The teacher had a whole class write for an hour about the back of his thumb, then another about a coin, ``and there wasn't a single complaint about `nothing to say.'\,'' This is the same book's anecdote, but it is its only sign that the method worked for more than one student.}
